suggestions.title: Increase Instagram posting frequency and content strategy
suggestions.problem: Instagram reach is critically low (2 reach/day), indicating minimal content distribution or posting activity
suggestions.root_cause: Likely infrequent posting schedule or lack of content strategy. A single post or no recent posts would result in near-zero reach metrics
suggestions.suggestion: Implement a consistent posting schedule of 4-5 posts per week featuring bakery/cafe discovery content: new shop spotlights, seasonal pastries, behind-the-scenes prep, user-generated content, and collection guides. Use Instagram Stories daily for real-time engagement
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase Instagram reach from 2 to 50-100+ per day within 2 weeks; drive 15-25% referral traffic from Instagram to website
suggestions.implementation_note: Create content calendar: Mon/Wed/Fri = Shop features (carousel), Tue/Thu = Pastry close-ups (Reels), Daily = Stories. Example post: '東京のクロワッサン専門店3選' with location tags and shop links directing to Chirumaru website

suggestions.title: Improve session-to-engagement conversion rate
suggestions.problem: Website engagement rate is only 44-71% (engaged_sessions vs total sessions), with 20-50% of sessions showing zero engagement. Recent dates (8/20-8/21) show 0% engagement
suggestions.root_cause: Landing page friction, unclear value proposition, slow load times, or poor mobile UX. Users arrive but don't interact with bakery listings, filters, or details
suggestions.suggestion: Audit and optimize landing page: (1) Add above-fold bakery discovery feature with search/filter buttons; (2) Ensure mobile responsiveness (test on iPhone/Android); (3) Add trust signals (total shops listed, recent reviews); (4) Implement 'Featured Bakeries This Week' prominently; (5) Reduce time-to-interactive below 2 seconds
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase engaged_sessions ratio from 44% to 65-75% within 1 week; convert more visitors into active users (+30% active user rate)
suggestions.implementation_note: Add above-fold CTA: <button class='discover-btn'>近所のパン屋さんを探す</button> with location-based search. Implement Lighthouse performance audit targeting 75+ score. Test with 10 users via session replay tool to identify friction points

suggestions.title: Implement retargeting and email nurturing for inactive sessions
suggestions.problem: High session volume (5-9 sessions daily) but low active_users (2-4), indicating repeat low-engagement visitors or users not returning. Weekend traffic collapse (Aug 16-17, Aug 21) suggests poor content timing
suggestions.root_cause: One-time visitors leaving without saving shops or creating accounts. No mechanism to re-engage users with personalized recommendations or reminders
suggestions.suggestion: Deploy email capture at exit-intent with incentive: '新しいパン屋さんの情報をメールで受け取る' (Get new bakery alerts via email). Send weekly curated shop recommendations based on user's search history. Use Google Analytics remarketing to show ads to past visitors
suggestions.expected_impact: Convert 20-30% of one-time visitors to repeat users; increase active_users from 2-4 to 6-10 daily; improve engaged_sessions by 25-40%
suggestions.implementation_note: Implement exit-intent popup: IF (time_on_page < 30s AND scroll_depth < 25%) THEN show_modal('email_capture'). Send weekly digest: 'あなたの地域の新しいパン屋さん3選' with shop images, ratings, and direct links to Chirumaru detail pages
